title: RankEvolve: A Reliable Multi-Agent Auto-Research Harness for Evolving Ranking Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.39551v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Auto-research agents, LLM systems that propose, implement, train, and evaluate model changes across iterations, promise to automate applied ML's experimental loop. Over long horizons, execution accuracy is a binding constraint: a change can silently leak held-out data, omit normalization, disconnect a gradient, or leave a train/eval flag unwired, invalidating expensive runs and compounding error across iterations. We present RankEvolve, an auto-research framework for evolving generative ranking models. An Executable Operating Protocol (EOP) declares phases, gates, branches, and loops, and the runtime enforces the compiled state machine. A meta-meta-harness composes complete black-box coding-agent products, including Claude Code and Codex, as execution-graph nodes that review and repair one another's work. In a budget-matched evaluation, heterogeneous composition raises all-oracle execution accuracy from the best single-product baseline o

translated_title: RankEvolve：一个用于演化排序模型的可靠多智能体自动化研究框架
translated_abstract: 自动化研究智能体是指能够在迭代过程中提出、实现、训练和评估模型变更的LLM系统，有望将应用机器学习的实验循环实现自动化。在长周期运行中，执行准确性是一个关键约束：一次变更可能悄悄泄露保留数据、遗漏归一化操作、断开梯度连接，或使训练/评估标志未正确接线，从而使昂贵的实验失效并在多次迭代中累积误差。我们提出了RankEvolve，一个用于演化生成式排序模型的自动化研究框架。一个可执行操作协议声明了阶段、门控、分支和循环，由运行时强制执行编译后的状态机。一个元-元框架将完整的黑盒编码智能体产品（包括Claude Code和Codex）组合为执行图节点，这些节点可以相互审查并修复彼此的工作。在预算匹配的评估中，异构组合方式将全oracle执行准确性从最佳单产品基线提升……（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出RankEvolve框架，通过可执行操作协议强制执行状态机，并将Claude Code、Codex等异构黑盒编码智能体组合为可相互审查与修复的执行图节点，显著提升排序模型自动化研究中的执行准确性。
en_tdlr: RankEvolve is an auto-research framework that improves execution accuracy in evolving ranking models by enforcing a compiled state machine via an Executable Operating Protocol and composing heterogeneous black-box coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) that review and repair each other's work.
